title: Juicy Mexican Meat Skillet
description: A rich, flavorful dish from Chiapas, Mexico, featuring a mixture of spices and a shio-koji cure.
instructions: Heat the lard or oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the pork cubes and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside. Reduce heat to medium.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the chili powder, mixture powder, shio-koji cure, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned pork back into the skillet and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the dish simmer, covered, for 15 minutes or until the pork is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
